annotations.title: Upload a video straight into Google Ads

description: Upload a Hermoso video (render id, Library id, attachment://N or Hermoso link) straight into Google Ads — no YouTube channel needed: it goes UNLISTED to the Google-managed channel of the ad account (or to your own brand channel with channelId, where PUBLIC is allowed). Waits for YouTube to process it, then returns the video asset ready for create_google_ads_demand_gen_campaign or Performance Max. AI-generated renders are disclosed as such. action "status" finishes a slow one (uploadId), "list" shows uploads, "remove" deletes one (confirm:true). Free.

aiGenerated.description: Google Ads generative-content disclosure. OMIT IT and Hermoso decides from provenance: a Hermoso render is declared, a video that came through upload_file (the user’s own footage) is NOT. true/false overrides

channelId.description: your own YouTube channel (UC…), else Google's

confirm.description: true to remove the upload (action remove); every ad using the video stops showing it

customerId.description: Google Ads account id, 10 digits (dashes ok); omit for the brand's default account

description.description: YouTube description for the uploaded video (optional)

dryRun.description: true = build and return the request without uploading any bytes

loginCustomerId.description: manager (MCC) account id, when the account is managed through one

privacy.description: UNLISTED (default, the only option on Google's channel) or PUBLIC (own channel only, with channelId)

uploadId.description: upload id from the upload reply or action list; required for status and remove

video.description: Hermoso render id, Library id, attachment://N or Hermoso video link

waitSeconds.description: seconds to wait for YouTube to finish processing, max 240; default 90 on upload, 0 on status
